name: activity-feed
summary: Presents chronological operational events with actor, detail, time, and semantic tone.

agent.useWhen: A detail page needs a concise chronological history of actions or state changes.
agent.avoidWhen: Users compare many events across fixed columns or need audit-log filtering.

contract.role: labelled ordered list with machine-readable native time elements
invariants: One to 100 ordered entries with nonblank plain-text visible time labels.
occurredAt must be a real calendar-valid RFC3339 timestamp with timezone; regex-only acceptance is insufficient.

Portable hrefs accept only the package safe HTTP(S), relative, or application path policy. Native JSON hrefs also accept whole named routes calls; the host checks route existence, argument types, codecs and emission provenance.
All text and attributes are escaped; no script or raw HTML is emitted.
